title: Memory management: who gets the GPU

questions.q: Why is a second run with the same model faster?
options: Models stay loaded until the room is needed
Weights are compressed after the first run
questions.answer: Models stay loaded until the room is needed
questions.why: free_memory evicts only when required, and the cache also holds results.

questions.q: The room requested before loading is
A 12 GB model on an 8 GB card, on the estimate-based path:
options: Loads partly, with the rest kept in RAM, and runs more slowly
questions.answer: Loads partly, with the rest kept in RAM, and runs more slowly

options: Leaves that amount for other software
questions.answer: Leaves that amount for other software

questions.q: What does ComfyUI do on an out-of-memory error during a node?
options: Reports the error and unloads all models
questions.answer: Reports the error and unloads all models
questions.why: The except branch of execute in execution.py calls unload_all_models.
